message: Statement and config are aligned. Log transform with naive inverse (exp(pred)−1) is specified in statement; config sets log:true for treatment and log:false for comparator. No bias correction is explicit in statement; config contains no correction fields. Demand lags [1,2,3,4], rolling means [4,13], alpha=1.0, and all exclusions (no yoy, promo, trend, cat, clip, window, series_mean) match exactly between statement and config. Two-way bootstrap (series × rolling-origin) is a valid estimation method not contradicted by config. Ready to lock and execute.
